decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding condition the proposal, because of its size, design and appearance, would complement the appearance of the locality and would enhance employment opportunities within the Borough. It would not harm neighbours' living conditions and would provide adequate parking levels. The development complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), E.1.1 (Location of new employment development), E.2.1 (Environmental Criteria) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected.  The boundary treatment shall be completed before (the use hereby permitted is commenced) or (before the building(s) is/are occupied) or (in accordance with a timetable agreed in writing with the local planning authority).  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 5 - The entrance to the building shall have a clear opening of at least 900mm and level threshold access.

Condition : 6 - Before the development hereby permitted commences the applicant must:Investigate the site for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the LPA, to ascertain whether gas protection measures are required. Where measures are required the details shall be submitted to, and approved by, the LPA.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Variation of Condition 1 (Timescales) of permission 01254/75/P6 to allow a further 5 years for implementation (Erection of 2 storey office building with associated parking).
